book.name: Matai
book.title: Yesu Kalisi-te banye nivasa lohvu Matai kaavu

content: Lako Yesu la vu Pilata
Samiinaanôôn atombe Yuda-te himbop-aso osin kul vaha sen datung salivangin-ato silate yêêv-aso pin lanjôôy vakasin nambe lanyiis Yesu be jimb,
om sil talu de laandiiy-ambe lala vu yêêv bop Lom ti, haale nambe Pilata.
Yudas vaaku ka

+ o 27:3 Mat 26:14-15*Tombe omaaho sen taato Yesu langaah-ato Yudas, ond yi de yêêv-aso lango Yesu-te vakasin-ambe lanêêl nambe jimb, tombe lopayo nimeen ak in nambe yoo wiing Yesu paya, om hako mone siliva doo-ti be nomaayuuh-anju laah vu yêêv-aso salivangin-ate osin himbop-aso,
tombe nêêl nambe, “Soo aawiing omaaho sen nipaya me-neep vu yii-juuto paya, be saavu lukala ham namam in nambe ham anyiis-ambe jimb.” Le sil lanêêl nambe, “Hey-ame heyate va le, goo gate va.”
Tombe Yudas haate monêê-ju lukala dumb vaambuung alo, tonde hato laah voon-ambe la vaaku ka be yimb.
Tombe yêêv-aso salivangin-ate paatuk monêê-ju be lanêêl nambe, “Monêê-jo yiiy vaanggo omaaho ti nihees ak, om me-lohvu nambe yiiy gatung dukana gaving mone salivangin-ate le.”

Om sil lakaas in lung la tonde mem lako monêê-ju be lala laanggo ngaanggis boow ti vu hil sen dawiing kul in davu samu dêêngg-ato, in nambe landaav hil bamaan vu taaku ango danjip hôôk ngaanggis-anju,
ondeey danêêl taakuu-ju haale nambe Ngaanggis Ngaamong Nihees-ate be neep-ambe gêên-anju.

+ o 27:9 Sek 11:12-13; Jer 32:6-9*Ond vaa-ju wiing-ambe Anutu-te vakasin sen Yelemia nêêl bôôy-ato nôôn ak nambe, “Lako mone siliva doo-ti be nomaayuuh sen hil Islel laliinggis nambe sil e baanggo yi jak-ato,
tombe laanggo ngaanggis boow ti vu omaaho sen navu samu dêêngg-ato, lohvu Omaaho Bop nêêl vu saa-to.”
Pilata lingin Yesu
Tombe Yesu la naale yêêv bop Pilata me, tombe yêêv lingin nambe, “Yuda-te omaaho lulemak hong a?” Tombe Yesu liinggis nambe, “Yik ganêêl-anja.”
+ o 27:12 Ais 53:7; Mat 26:63*Tonde kul vaha sen datung salivangin-ato silate yêêv-aso osin himbop-aso lanêêl vakasin lak yi, lemu Yesu me-nêêl vakasin ti laah e.
Tombe Pilata nêêl vu Yesu nambe, “Game nango vakasin ngeeyaata sen danêêl lak hong-anja le?”
+ o 27:14 Jon 19:9*Le ma de Yesu me-nêêl vakasin ti laah vu le, om yêêv-anju ka la ngeey.
Pilata liinggis nambe lanyiis Yesu jak haah pako

Lohvu ta pin hôôk hil Yuda-te busin bop busin haluusin sen Anutu haluuh hil Islel hôôk vu Ijip bôôy-ato, ond silate gambum ti neep nambe sil davu kataangg kalaambus-aso ti de Pilata navu kavaayin kalaambus tii-ju be navu la malis vu sil.
Tombe hôôk busin-anju ond kalaambus ti haale nambe Balabas nando, ond hil pin lango haale,
om sen hil Yuda lasupin sil lala vu Pilataa-to ond lingin sil nambe, “Om ham awiingin nambe sa kavaayin omaaho ango tana vu ham? Sa kavaayin Balabas me sa kavaayin Yesu sen danêêl nambe Kalisii-to?”
+ o 27:18 Jon 11:47-48; 12:19*Pilata lingin sil nambêênjo in lak ni nambe sil ahend anipaya vu Yesu, ondeey sil laandiiy la vu yi.
Tombe Pilata naahen nando nangoyin vakasin, tonde vane wiing vakasin la hato vu nambe, “Game namam jak omaaho nivalok-anju le, in saahe mavin ti lak yi gêên, tombe wiing-ambe sa nahangg lak lôôt.”
Le ma de kul vaha sen datung salivangin-ato silate yêêv-aso osin himbop-aso laanjiihin hil ngeeyaataa-ju nambe sil daanêêl vu Pilata naambe kavaayin Balabas vu sil, de nyiis Yesu be jimb.
+ o 27:21 Sin 3:14*Tombe yêêv-anju lingin sil yesin laah nambe, “Om ham awiingin nambe sa kavaayin omaaho yuuh-anju ango tana vu ham?” Tombe lanêêl nambe, “Okavaayin Balabas.”
Tombe Pilata nêêl vu sil nambe, “De Yesu sen danêêl nambe Kalisii-to ond saambiing vaati vu?” Le sil pin lanêêl nambe, “Ganyiis jakana haah pako.”
Tombe lingin sil nambe, “In? Wiing vaati paya deey?” Le ma de sil oo lateey niwêêk lôôt nambe, “Ganyiis jakana haah pako.”

+ o 27:24 Diu 21:6-9; Mat 27:4*Tombe Pilata yi nambe sil-ame le gango lava le, ma, ngaaho lak in lambiing ngaamong, om hako bel-ambe lipis nama nambe sen valoohin yi hôôk hil ngeeyaataa-ju mend de nêêl nambe, “Sa kaasêêh omaahôô-ju nihees ond nyevahaan-ame le nanjip vu sa le, ham oote va.”
+ o 27:25 Mat 23:35; Sin 5:28*Tombe hil pin lanêêl laah vu nambe, “Sen nihees kaasêêh-ato ond nyevahaan yoo le nanjip vu hey o noongg-aso.”
Tombe Pilata kavaayin Balabas-ambe vu la vu sil, de Yesu ond nêêl-ambe ahevaavu-so laveek lôôt, le mem vu lukala hil Lom ngaamong vaha-so namand in nambe lanyiis jakana haah pako.
Hil ngaamong vaha-so pale Yesu lôôt
Yêêv bop-ate hil ngaamong vaha-so lako Yesu be lalukala yêêv-ate taaku lopayo, tombe ngaamong vaha-so pin lasupin sil lalaam vu.
+ o 27:28 Luk 23:11*Tombe sil lakaah Yesu-te lolop-ande lalop lolop anihees ti lukala yi, be davu taahu omaaho lulemak lak yi.
Tonde lasêêy hees aniyin-ambe lambuuhin tombe latung lakala Yesu lu, tonde lavu paatôôn ngasing lukala nama vasa osin latung kaatu vu, de sil pale yi nambe, “Yuda-te omaaho lulemak, omando.”
+ o 27:30 Ais 50:6*Tombe sil kasuv ak me, de lalôôh paatôôn ngasing-ambe laveek Yesu lukook ak.
Sil pale Yesu lung la, le mem sil lakaah lolop anihees-anju vêêl in Yesu, de yoo lalop yite lolop lukalaah yi, tonde mem lako be lala in lanyiis jakana haah pako.
Layiis Yesu lakala haah pako
Lala lak atonde latovu hil Sailini ti haale nambe Simon, tombe hil ngaamong vaha-so lanêêl niwêêk lôôt vu yi om kava Yesu-te haah pako.
Lala lato taaku ti haale nambe Golagaata, dangga nambe taaku lukook,
+ o 27:34 Saam 69:21*tombe sil kaasêêh malaasin anikalin ti
lukala wain-ande lavu vu Yesu in nambe naanum, tombe tep, le ma de nimbaya.
+ o 27:35 Saam 22:18*Tombe hil ngaamong vaha-so layiis Yesu lakala haah pako lung la, tonde sil laate tatuuh-ambe tambe lak Yesu-te lolop-ande latiiy lohvu sil.
Lung laa tonde mondanggin yi be dandôô-ju,
tonde sil kaavu vakasin sen lanêêl ak yii-to lakala neep haah pako lu baandoni nambe, “Yesu sen Yuda-te Omaaho Lulemak-anjo.”
+ o 27:38 Ais 53:12*Tombe layiis hil hôôndak yuuhapim daale having Yesu, ango naale nama vasa, de ango naale nama kêênj.
+ o 27:39 Saam 22:7; 109:25*Tombe hil sen daale danjung-anjuuto layi be lalaah namand vu, de laanggôôl Yesu

+ o 27:40 Mat 26:61; Jon 2:19*nambe, “Wopo, hong sen ganêêl nambe gale kawiiy Anutu-te dumb vaambuung, de nohvu busin yaal gale gandaav naah-ato, om goo gandôôvu hong. Naambe hong Anutu Noow ond goo gavuuh haah pakôô-ja de ganduus-ambe ganaam voon-o.”
Tonde yik kul vaha sen datung salivangin-ato silate yêêv-aso osin tanasin dangga-so de himbop-aso lawiing kangasin vu Yesu nambêênju having nambe,
+ o 27:42 Jon 11:50*“Hôôvu hil vaalu de me-lohvu nambe yoo dôôvu yi le. Om naambe Islel-ate omaaho lulemak yii-ju ond duus-ambe naam voon, tomem yaambiing gaving yi.
+ o 27:43 Saam 22:8; Jon 5:18*Yoo wii-having Anutu be nêêl nambe Anutu Noow yi, om peey naambe Anutu wiingin ond dôôvu yi.”
Tombe hil hôôndak yuuh sen layiis yuuh daale having Yesuu-to ond yuuh lanêêl Yesu pale nambêênju having.
Yesu yimb la
+ o 27:45 Emo 8:9*Tonde taaku mekaalus laam naale lavuun atombe taaku mekanu hôôk lohvu taaku pin-ambe laam soosin hôôk lohvu taaku me yaal.
+ o 27:46 Saam 22:1*Tombe taaku me yaal-anjo Yesu teey bopaata lôôt nambe, “Eli, Eli, lama sabatani?” Dangga nambe, “Sate Anutu, sate Anutu, nambe vaati om ohavuuh sa la?”
Tombe hil sen daalêê-juuto vaalu langoyin-ambe lanêêl nambe, “Nateey Eliya.”

+ o 27:48 Saam 69:21*Tonde sil ti saloongg pavis-ambe la hako malumak-ambe laanggôôl hôôk bel anikalin, tombe havingin malumak-anju hôôk ngasing vaha de hako be la vu lukala Yesu avi in nambe dasuvin.
Le hil vaalu lanêêl nambe, “Ham baale de yaangge naambe Eliya le naam dôôvu yi me le nama.”
Tombe Yesu teey bopaata lôôt yesin laah-ande yimb la.

+ o 27:51 Eks 26:31-33; Hiblu 10:19-20*Tombe tôômb bopaata dinaandiin lôôt, yik tôômb-anju yakaluuh Anutu-te dumb vaambuung alopayôô-to, ond kweek la yuuh vu vaavu be la hoow, tonde taaku yêêy osin tatuuh bo-bop hapok.
Tonde bandumb avi hataahin-ande Anutu-te hil ngeeyaata sen sil layimb lung laa-to ond sil kandi vasa hôôk osin nind naavi doos,
tombe sil lavuuh bandumb, tonde Yesu kandi lak vêêl e mem lalukala taaku vaambuung Yelusalem atombe hil ngeeyaata layi mend ak sil.

Tombe hil Lom ngaamong vaha-sote yêêv osin yite hil ngaamong vaha-so sen sil mondanggin Yesu-te haah pakôô-to having ond sil langoyin jemaapi yuuh va pin, tombe layêênin lôôt de lanêêl nambe, “Omaahôô-jo Anutu Noow keen.”
+ o 27:55 Luk 8:2-3*Tonde vêêh ngeeyaata daale diin daka be mondayi, ond sil sen sil mondahôôvu Yesu lak busin pin-ato ond sil taamuyin Yesu vu Galili be lalaam.
+ o 27:56 Mat 20:20*Tombe sil-anju yaal ond ti Malia vu Magadala, de ango Malia sen Jems ayuuh Yusep taandin-ato, tonde tik Sebedi noow Jems ayuuh Jon taandin.
Lambe Yesu naavi lukala lavandangga
Soosin hôôk atombe omaaho kupak dangga ti haale nambe Yusep vu Alimatia valup, ond Yesu-te hil ti yi,
+ o 27:58 Diu 21:22-23*ond la vu Pilata be kataangg Yesu naavi nambe gako be na gambe na, om Pilata nêêl-ambe lavu Yesu naavi vu yi.
Tombe Yusep hako Yesu naavi be vayum hôôk tôômb valôôy moos ti,
+ o 27:60 Ais 53:9*tombe yoo la hambe lukala neep hôôk yite lavandangga sen naahen sap hôôk tatuuh danggaa-to. Lung laa tonde tatolin tatuuh bopaata ti laah hilin bandumb avi jeen-ande la,
tonde Malia Magadala yuuh Malia ango dando mondayi lavandanggaa-ju nando vaalu.
Ahevaavu-so mondanggin bandumb
Busin sen hil Yuda samu sil in nambe lanja vanôôn busin haluusin-atêêto lung la, tonde kul vaha sen datung salivangin-ato silate yêêv-aso osin Palisai-so, sil lavuh ti be lala vu Pilata

+ o 27:63 Mat 12:40; 16:21; Jon 2:19-21*be lanêêl nambe, “Yêêv bop-e, mem gêên hey akangg vu vakasin ti sen omaaho tatuhin vahaa-ju naahen nando metumin-ande nêêl nambe, ‘Busin yaal jung na le mem sale kandi jak naah.’

Om onaanêêl-ambe ahevaavu-so lana ganggin bandumb-anju tatin-ambe busin yaal jung na le, in yite maanggêêm-aso le lana langgôôndak ninaavi de daanêêl vu hil naambe kandi lak vu hil yimbin-ate, tombe sil e tatuhin hil lôôt savok sen yoo tatuhin hil lung laa-to.”
Tombe Pilata nêêl vu sil nambe, “Hamate ahevaavu-so dando, om ham ana gatung sil mando in sil oo mongganggin bandumb avi nivasa lôôt.”
+ o 27:66 Dan 6:17*Tombe sil lala langgi va nikanggi lak tatuuh nanyendangga la vatinin bandumb avi, de latung ahevaavu-so dando mondanggin.

footnotes.text: Malaasin anikalin tii-jo haale nambe mul, ond haah ti nikanggi, ond davu vu hil in nambe sil anind naavi me-gasêêng e. Om sil lako be lavu vu Yesu tombe tep le ma de nimbaya, in wiingin nambe yoo gango nivaane be jimb.
